_comment: Intraday scalping rules over pivots, CPR and VWAP. Pass with --rules. Every rule also accepts severity (info|warn|alert), cooldown_s, and symbols (empty = all).

rules._note: CPR narrower than 0.25% of the pivot -- classic trending-day precondition. Fires once per session.
Closed outside TC/BC having been inside, on >1.2x median bar volume, on a narrow-ish CPR day.
Pierced TC/BC intrabar but closed back inside leaving a 40%+ wick -- the fade.
Price reclaimed or lost session VWAP with volume behind it.
Stretched 2 sigma from VWAP -- mean-reversion fade back toward the anchor.
A pivot or CPR edge sits on VWAP and price is there too. The highest-conviction zone.
Price reached one of the named levels. Keyed per level so each announces itself once.
